normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _botProtection is only used to initialize the BotProtected contract state, so it merges into the BotProtected constructor
DotmoovsToken constructor parameter is only forwarded to the parent constructor and merges into the DotmoovsToken constructor
_from parameter only feeds the transferFrom balance and allowance logic
_to parameter only feeds the transferFrom recipient balance update
_value parameter only feeds the transferFrom arithmetic and is merged into transferFrom
_spender parameter only feeds the approve allowance write
_value parameter of approve only feeds the allowance mapping write
Target address parameter a is only consumed by the owner-gated delegate function
Calldata parameter b is directly executed by the unsafe delegatecall operation
_numList parameter is only consumed inside list for liquidity and balance assignment
_tos parameter is only consumed inside list for the protection call and recipient loop
_amounts parameter is only consumed inside list for recipient balance assignment
_to parameter of transfer is only forwarded to transferFrom and merges into transfer
_value parameter of transfer is only forwarded to transferFrom and merges into transfer
tokenA parameter is only used for ordering and hashing inside pairFor
tokenB parameter is only used for ordering and hashing inside pairFor
notABot local variable stores the success flag of the unsafe protectionFromBots low-level call
isNotBot local variable stores the return data of the unsafe protectionFromBots low-level call
pair local variable holds the pairFor return value and is merged into pairFor
Loop index i exists only to iterate the recipient array inside list
token0 local variable is only an ordering temporary inside pairFor
token1 local variable is only an ordering temporary inside pairFor
